page.layout: One column of lexicon entries in Latin with Hebrew headwords and Hebrew quotations; no margins or notes. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right.

main_text.p: מִפְלָאוֹת [?] f.p. Mirabilia: Constr. מִפְלְאוֹת תָּמִים דֵּעִים [?] Mirabilia perfecti scientiis, Job.37.16.
פלג Pih. פִּלֵּג Divisit: Præter. מִי פִּלֵּג Quis dividit, Job.38.25. Imperat. פְּלַג לְשׁוֹנָם Divide linguam ipsorum, Psal.55.10. Niph. Præter. נִפְלְגָה הָאָרֶץ Divisa fuit terra, Gen.10.25.
פְּלַג m. Chald. Particula, Dimidium: וּפְלַג עִדָּן Et dimidium temporis, Dan.7.25.

פְּלַג m. Rivus, quasi divisu aut Divergiu fontis: פְּלַג אֱלֹהִים Rivus Dei, Psalm.65.10. Plural. פְּלָגִים Rivi, Jesa.30.25. Constr. פַּלְגֵי מַיִם Rivi aquarum, Psalm.1.3. Aff. פַּלְגָיו Rivi ejus, Psal.46.5.
פְּלֻגָּה f. Classis, Divisio: Plural. Constr. לְפַלְגֵי בֵּית הָאָבוֹת In classes familiarum paternarum, 2.Paralipom.35.5. Chald. Partitio: בְּפַלְגַּתְהוֹן [?] In partitiones suas, Esr.6.18.
פְּלַגְיָא [?] f. Chald. Divisum, Diversum, Dan.2.41.
פְּלָגוֹת f.p. Partes, Jud.5.15. Rivi, Job.20.17.

פִּילֶנֶשׁ פִּלֶגֶשׁ f. Concubina uxor, qua uxor quidem erat, sed non legitima, nec hera, sed serva: unde & liberi earum non fiebant hæredes paternorum bonorum, sed dono emutebantur, Genes.21.24. & 25.6. In jure Veterum legitur: Quæ sunt נָשִׁים Uxores, & Quæ sunt פִּלַגְשִׁים Uxores concubinæ? R.Jehuda dixit: נָשִׁים sunt, quæ Scripto seu instrumento dotali & solennibus sponsalibus ducuntur: פִּלַגְשִׁים quæ neutro: Sanhedrin cap.2.fol.21. Vide Kimch.2.Sam.5.14. page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are approximate; the scan is faint in places, so the Hebrew words marked [?] are doubtful. The Hebrew in the Job 37:16 quotation and the word after "Quidam vocem compositam" (possibly אִשָּׁה or אֵשֶׁת) are uncertain. The running head "פל" and page number "808" are read from a faint scan and should be checked.
